news.title: When I see posts from or about people in the technology industry, and read they've lost th…
news.author: ReadingTheDots@vivaldi.net
news.snippet: When I see posts from or about people in the technology industry, and read they've lost their job and often can't find work, even though their skilled, but AI has changed that. Now human skills don't matter as much, and may soon not matter at all. I said this, from the beginning, when I first heard about AI. I had a very selfish thought then, which was, I'm glad I retired. Then I started thinking of the economic impact on people and families. Some people don't have a parent's basement to relocate too. Some people have kids in college and don't know where they're going to find the money to help their kids, or maybe even put food on the table. I mean, one can only work so many low-paying, no benefits jobs. 😭 So, if you're going to preach to me about the wonders of AI, I'm going to preach to you about the economic harm it is doing, not to mention environmental harm, but that deserves its own post. # AI # technology # harm
